news.summary: A Bengaluru firm, Digantara, analyzed Chinese space activity and found 37 pre-planned maneuvers by Yaogan satellites between April 15 and 30, 2025, boosting passes over Pahalgam—six days before the April 22 terror attack on tourists at Baisaran meadow near Pahalgam, claimed by a Lashkar-e-Taiba-linked group. news.summary: The strikes targeted the Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez refinery, which processes 13 million tonnes of crude yearly, along with the Novoshakhtinsk refinery in Rostov and the Kaleykino oil pumping station in Tatarstan. news.summary: On November 7, the Comoros-flagged MV Star Line was intercepted near Belawan while heading from China to Bangladesh's Mongla Port.
